name: Agriculture
overview: Scripture reveals agriculture as a divine institution established by God at creation, where the earth produces seed and fruit according to its kind, and man is placed to dress and keep the garden (Genesis 1:12; 2:15). After the Fall, toil and labor became necessary, as man must eat bread by the sweat of his face and till the ground from which he was formed (Genesis 3:19, 3:23). Agriculture is not only a means of provision but also reflects human responsibility and God's sustaining order, with seedtime and harvest continuing as long as the earth endures (Genesis 8:22). Cain exemplifies early agricultural practice as a tiller of the ground, underscoring the biblical foundation for husbandry and labor.
